footer.disclaimer: This is a branch information page, not the official Lotus website.
privacy.p1: This is a branch information page. It has no forms, no accounts, and does not collect visitors' personal data. It uses a cookie-free visitor counter (GoatCounter) to count visits and button clicks such as call and directions, anonymously and without cross-site tracking.
privacy.p2: The site remembers your language choice (Thai/English) in your own browser only. Nothing is sent anywhere.
privacy.p3: The embedded map and links to LINE, Facebook and Google Maps are third-party services with their own privacy policies.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes, through Lotus's official website and app. This branch does not run its own online store.
faq.q2: Are prices and products the same as the official site?
faq.a2: This page shows no prices because prices and stock vary by branch. Check the official website or app, or call the branch.
faq.q3: Where is the branch and how do I get there?
faq.a3: See the map and landmarks under Getting here, or tap Directions above.
faq.q4: Is this the official Lotus website?
faq.a4: No. This is a branch information page. The official site is lotuss.com.
